/*DATA*/

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), $$=s=>Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(s));
const J=id=>JSON.parse(document.getElementById(id).textContent);
const NS="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
const FOREST=J("data-forest"), MECH=J("data-mechanism"), ADOPT=J("data-adopter"), CLOS=J("data-closure"), CASES=J("data-cases"), STEP=J("data-stepper");
const EV={};
[["screen","data-events-screen"],["heldout","data-events-heldout"],["mesh","data-events-mesh"]].forEach(([k,id])=>{
  const d=J(id); EV[k]=d.rows.map((r,i)=>{const o={i};d.cols.forEach((c,j)=>o[c]=r[j]);return o;});
});
const FOLDNAME={screen:"Screen",heldout:"Held-out",mesh:"MeSH"};

/* ---------- formatting ---------- */
const f2=x=>(Math.round(x*100+1e-9*Math.sign(x))/100).toFixed(2);
const f3=x=>(Math.round(x*1000+1e-9*Math.sign(x))/1000).toFixed(3);
const f1=x=>(Math.round(x*10)/10).toFixed(1);
function fp(p){ if(p==null) return "n/a"; if(p<0.001) return "<0.001"; if(p<0.1) return f3(p); return f2(p); }
const pct=x=>Math.round(x*100)+"%";
const nf=x=>x.toLocaleString("en-US");
function esc(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]));}

/* ---------- glossary + term tooltips ---------- */
const TERMS={
  entry:["Host-entry event","The first year in which a concept appears in a non-origin subfield together with at least five co-occurring partner terms."],
  share:["Host-vocabulary share","The tag-weighted mean of each partner's pre-entry publication share in the host subfield, where each co-occurrence edge is weighted by its association strength."],
  ct:["Co-transfer","The fraction of entry partners that were origin companions of the concept in the five years before entry."],
  newcomer:["Newcomer uptake","The count of host-subfield papers by author-disjoint newcomers (authors with no prior concept paper and no co-authorship with concept authors) during the five years after entry."],
  irr:["IRR per SD","Incidence-rate ratio per one standard deviation of host-vocabulary share: the multiplicative change in expected newcomer papers. 1 means no effect."],
  ppml:["PPML","Poisson pseudo-maximum-likelihood regression, here with concept-clustered standard errors."],
  co:["Co-primary specification","PPML with concept, entry-year and host fixed effects, declared for use when the primary drops below 30 concept clusters."],
  pri:["Primary specification","PPML with concept-by-entry-year and host-by-entry-year fixed effects. It absorbs more confounding but keeps fewer events."],
  ivw:["IVW","Inverse-variance weighting: pooling fold estimates with weights proportional to their precision."],
  screen:["Screen fold","The development fold of the main arXiv-derived concept pool (202 concepts after grounding filters)."],
  heldout:["Held-out fold","The second main-arm fold (100 concepts after grounding filters). It was used in pipeline development, so its estimates are development-set estimates."],
  mesh:["MeSH population","An independent biomedical arm of 191 concepts drawn from new MeSH descriptors; its host-entry test is the independent replication."],
  ext:["Extensive margin","Whether any newcomer uptake occurs, modelled with a linear probability model."],
  int:["Intensive margin","The count of newcomer papers given that uptake started, modelled with PPML conditional on uptake."],
  rooted:["Rooted entry","An entry that reaches binary establishment: at least five newcomer papers in at least three of the five years after entry."],
  persist:["Persistent-neighbour closure","The closure coefficient restricted to the top-20 neighbours present in both year y and y-1."],
  burt:["Burt constraint","A measure of how redundant a node's ego network is. Brokerage in Burt's sense means low constraint."],
  holm:["Holm correction","A step-down correction of p-values for testing several hypotheses at once."],
  sust:["Sustained uptake","A concept-year reaching at least 20 papers per year and gaining at least 20 percentile points in co-word network strength relative to the focal population."]
};
let ttN=0;
function wireTerm(btn){
  const k=btn.dataset.term; if(!TERMS[k]) return;
  const t=document.createElement("span"); t.className="tt"; t.id="tt-"+(ttN++); t.setAttribute("role","tooltip");
  t.textContent=TERMS[k][1]; btn.appendChild(t); btn.setAttribute("aria-describedby",t.id);
  const open=()=>{ $$(".tt.on").forEach(o=>{if(o!==t)o.classList.remove("on");}); t.classList.add("on"); place(t); };
  btn.addEventListener("mouseenter",open); btn.addEventListener("focus",open); btn.addEventListener("click",e=>{e.stopPropagation();open();});
  btn.addEventListener("mouseleave",()=>t.classList.remove("on"));
  btn.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Escape")t.classList.remove("on");});
}
function place(t){ t.style.left="0px"; const r=t.getBoundingClientRect(); const over=r.right-(document.documentElement.clientWidth-8); if(over>0) t.style.left=(-over)+"px"; }
document.addEventListener("click",()=>$$(".tt.on").forEach(o=>o.classList.remove("on")));
document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Escape"){$$(".tt.on").forEach(o=>o.classList.remove("on"));hideTip();}});
function addTerms(root){ root.querySelectorAll("button.term:not([aria-describedby])").forEach(wireTerm); }

/* ---------- chart tooltip ---------- */
const tip=$("#tip");
function showTip(html,el,ev){
  tip.innerHTML=html; tip.classList.add("on");
  let x,y; if(ev&&ev.clientX!=null&&ev.type!=="focus"){x=ev.clientX;y=ev.clientY;} else {const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();x=r.left+r.width/2;y=r.top;}
  const w=tip.offsetWidth,h=tip.offsetHeight,vw=document.documentElement.clientWidth;
  let L=Math.min(Math.max(8,x+12),vw-w-8), T=y-h-12; if(T<8) T=y+16;
  tip.style.left=L+"px"; tip.style.top=T+"px";
}
function hideTip(){tip.classList.remove("on");}
document.addEventListener("click",e=>{ if(!e.target.closest||!e.target.closest(".mark")) hideTip(); });
window.addEventListener("scroll",hideTip,{passive:true});
function markify(g,html,label){
  g.classList.add("mark"); g.setAttribute("tabindex","0"); g.setAttribute("role","img"); g.setAttribute("aria-label",label);
  g.addEventListener("mouseenter",e=>showTip(html,g,e)); g.addEventListener("mousemove",e=>showTip(html,g,e));
  g.addEventListener("mouseleave",hideTip); g.addEventListener("focus",e=>showTip(html,g,e)); g.addEventListener("blur",hideTip);
  g.addEventListener("click",e=>{e.stopPropagation();showTip(html,g,e);});
}

/* ---------- svg helpers ---------- */
function el(tag,attrs,parent,text){const e=document.createElementNS(NS,tag);for(const k in attrs)e.setAttribute(k,attrs[k]);if(text!=null)e.textContent=text;if(parent)parent.appendChild(e);return e;}
function newSvg(container,W,H,title){
  container.innerHTML=""; const s=el("svg",{viewBox:`0 0 ${W} ${H}`,width:W,height:H,role:"group"},container);
  if(title){el("title",{},s,title);} return s;
}
function textW(svg,strs,cls){ const g=el("g",{},svg); let m=0; strs.forEach(s=>{const t=el("text",{class:cls},g,s); m=Math.max(m,t.getComputedTextLength());}); g.remove(); return m; }
function niceTicksLin(lo,hi,n){const span=hi-lo;const step0=span/n;const mag=Math.pow(10,Math.floor(Math.log10(step0)));const st=[1,2,2.5,5,10].map(m=>m*mag).find(s=>s>=step0);const out=[];for(let v=Math.ceil(lo/st)*st;v<=hi+1e-9;v+=st)out.push(+v.toFixed(10));return out;}
const cw=c=>Math.max(300,Math.min(c.clientWidth||600,1000));

/* Horizontal interval chart. rows: {label, est, lo, hi, color, shape, filled, tipHtml, aria, valText, group} */
function intervalChart(container,rows,o){
  const W=cw(container), rowH=o.rowH||30, top=14, bottom=48;
  const H=top+bottom+rows.length*rowH;
  const svg=newSvg(container,W,H,o.title);
  const labW=textW(svg,rows.map(r=>r.label),"lab")+12;
  const valW=o.hideVals?0:textW(svg,rows.map(r=>r.valText||""),"val")+14;
  const L=Math.min(labW,W*0.42), R=W-valW-10;
  const log=!!o.log;
  let lo=Math.min(o.ref,...rows.map(r=>r.lo)), hi=Math.max(o.ref,...rows.map(r=>r.hi));
  if(o.domain){lo=o.domain[0];hi=o.domain[1];}
  const pad=(log?Math.log(hi/lo):hi-lo)*0.06;
  let d0=log?Math.log(lo)-pad:lo-pad, d1=log?Math.log(hi)+pad:hi+pad;
  const X=v=>L+( (log?Math.log(v):v)-d0)/(d1-d0)*(R-L);
  let ticks;
  if(log){ const c=[0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8,0.9,1,1.1,1.25,1.5,1.75,2,2.5,3,4,5,6,8]; ticks=c.filter(v=>Math.log(v)>=d0&&Math.log(v)<=d1); if(ticks.length>7) ticks=ticks.filter((v,i)=>i%2===0||v===1); }
  else ticks=niceTicksLin(d0,d1,5);
  const plotB=top+rows.length*rowH;
  ticks.forEach(t=>{const x=X(t);el("line",{x1:x,x2:x,y1:top,y2:plotB,class:"gl"},svg);el("text",{x:x,y:plotB+16,"text-anchor":"middle",class:"tick"},svg,log?String(t):(Math.abs(t)<1e-9?"0":String(+t.toFixed(3))));});
  el("line",{x1:X(o.ref),x2:X(o.ref),y1:top-4,y2:plotB,stroke:"#555","stroke-dasharray":"5 4","stroke-width":1.2},svg);
  el("text",{x:(L+R)/2,y:plotB+38,"text-anchor":"middle",class:"axt"},svg,o.xTitle);
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>{
    const y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2;
    if(r.group){el("line",{x1:0,x2:W,y1:y-rowH/2,y2:y-rowH/2,stroke:"#d8dad5"},svg);}
    el("text",{x:L-12,y:y+4,"text-anchor":"end",class:"lab","font-weight":r.bold?700:400,fill:r.faint?"#6b7280":"#1b2029"},svg,r.label);
    const g=el("g",{},svg);
    el("rect",{x:L,y:y-rowH/2,width:R-L,height:rowH,fill:"transparent"},g);
    el("line",{x1:X(r.lo),x2:X(r.hi),y1:y,y2:y,stroke:r.color,"stroke-width":2.4},g);
    [r.lo,r.hi].forEach(v=>el("line",{x1:X(v),x2:X(v),y1:y-5,y2:y+5,stroke:r.color,"stroke-width":1.6},g));
    const x=X(r.est);
    if(r.shape==="diamond") el("path",{d:`M${x},${y-7}L${x+7},${y}L${x},${y+7}L${x-7},${y}Z`,fill:r.filled===false?"#fff":r.color,stroke:r.color,"stroke-width":2,class:"hl"},g);
    else el("circle",{cx:x,cy:y,r:6,fill:r.filled===false?"#fff":r.color,stroke:r.color,"stroke-width":2,class:"hl"},g);
    if(!o.hideVals) el("text",{x:R+12,y:y+4,class:"val"},svg,r.valText||"");
    markify(g,r.tipHtml,r.aria);
  });
  return svg;
}

/* Vertical bar chart from zero. bars:{label,value,color,tipHtml,aria,valText} */
function barChart(container,bars,o){
  const W=cw(container), H=o.H||240, top=20;
  const svg=newSvg(container,W,H,o.title);
  const maxV=Math.max(o.minMax||0,...bars.map(b=>b.value));
  const ticks=niceTicksLin(0,maxV*1.08||1,4);
  const tickLabs=ticks.map(t=>o.fmtTick?o.fmtTick(t):String(t));
  const tw=textW(svg,tickLabs,"tick");
  const L=tw+36, R=W-10;
  const catLines=bars.map(b=>String(b.label).split("\n"));
  const nLines=Math.max(...catLines.map(l=>l.length));
  const bottom=22+nLines*15;
  const yMax=ticks[ticks.length-1]||1;
  const Y=v=>top+(1-v/yMax)*(H-top-bottom);
  ticks.forEach((t,i)=>{el("line",{x1:L,x2:R,y1:Y(t),y2:Y(t),class:"gl"},svg);el("text",{x:L-6,y:Y(t)+4,"text-anchor":"end",class:"tick"},svg,tickLabs[i]);});
  el("text",{transform:`translate(${14},${(top+H-bottom)/2}) rotate(-90)`,"text-anchor":"middle",class:"axt"},svg,o.yTitle);
  const bw=(R-L)/bars.length;
  bars.forEach((b,i)=>{
    const x=L+i*bw+bw*0.18, w=bw*0.64;
    const g=el("g",{},svg);
    el("rect",{x:x,y:Y(b.value),width:w,height:Math.max(0,Y(0)-Y(b.value)),fill:b.color,class:"hl",rx:2},g);
    el("text",{x:x+w/2,y:Y(b.value)-5,"text-anchor":"middle",class:"val"},svg,b.valText);
    catLines[i].forEach((ln,j)=>el("text",{x:x+w/2,y:H-bottom+16+j*15,"text-anchor":"middle",class:"tick"},svg,ln));
    markify(g,b.tipHtml,b.aria);
  });
  el("line",{x1:L,x2:R,y1:Y(0),y2:Y(0),stroke:"#555"},svg);
  return svg;
}

/* ========== 1. Forest ========== */
const ivw=FOREST.ivw;
(function(){
  const mesh=FOREST.rows.find(r=>r.fold==="MeSH"&&r.spec==="co");
  $("#big-num").innerHTML=Math.round((mesh.irr-1)*100)+"%<small> per SD</small>";
  $("#big-cap").textContent=`Co-primary IRR ${f2(mesh.irr)}, 95% CI ${f2(mesh.lo)} to ${f2(mesh.hi)}, ${nf(mesh.N)} events in ${mesh.G} concept clusters; pre-registered verdict REPLICATED.`;
})();
function drawForest(){
  const spec=$('input[name=spec]:checked').value, ct=$("#show-ct").checked;
  const COL={Screen:"#0a5ea8","Held-out":"#0a5ea8",MeSH:"#1b7f5a"};
  const rows=[];
  FOREST.rows.filter(r=>r.spec===spec).forEach(r=>{
    const sp=spec==="co"?"Co-primary":"Primary";
    rows.push({label:`${r.fold}: host share`,est:r.irr,lo:r.lo,hi:r.hi,color:COL[r.fold],filled:spec==="co",group:rows.length>0,bold:true,
      valText:`${f2(r.irr)} [${f2(r.lo)}, ${f2(r.hi)}]  p ${fp(r.p)}`,
      tipHtml:`<b>${r.fold}, ${sp}</b><br>Host-vocabulary share IRR/SD ${f2(r.irr)}<br>95% CI ${f2(r.lo)} to ${f2(r.hi)}, p ${fp(r.p)}<br>N ${nf(r.N)} events, G ${r.G} concepts<br><span style="opacity:.8">${esc(r.src)}</span>`,
      aria:`${r.fold} ${sp} host share IRR ${f2(r.irr)}, CI ${f2(r.lo)} to ${f2(r.hi)}`});
    if(ct) rows.push({label:`${r.fold}: co-transfer`,est:r.ct,lo:r.ct_lo,hi:r.ct_hi,color:"#8a909b",shape:"diamond",faint:true,
      valText:`${f2(r.ct)} [${f2(r.ct_lo)}, ${f2(r.ct_hi)}]  p ${fp(r.ct_p)}`,
      tipHtml:`<b>${r.fold}, ${sp}: co-transfer</b><br>IRR/SD ${f2(r.ct)}, 95% CI ${f2(r.ct_lo)} to ${f2(r.ct_hi)}, p ${fp(r.ct_p)}`,
      aria:`${r.fold} co-transfer IRR ${f2(r.ct)}, p ${fp(r.ct_p)}`});
  });
  if(spec==="co") rows.push({label:"IVW pooled: host share",est:ivw.irr,lo:ivw.lo,hi:ivw.hi,color:"#c26a00",shape:"diamond",group:true,bold:true,
      valText:`${f2(ivw.irr)} [${f2(ivw.lo)}, ${f2(ivw.hi)}]  I² ${ivw.I2.toFixed(0)}`,
      tipHtml:`<b>Inverse-variance weighted pooled co-primary estimate</b><br>IRR/SD ${f2(ivw.irr)}, 95% CI ${f2(ivw.lo)} to ${f2(ivw.hi)}, I² = ${ivw.I2.toFixed(0)}<br><span style="opacity:.8">${esc(ivw.src)}</span>`,
      aria:`IVW pooled IRR ${f2(ivw.irr)}`});
  intervalChart($("#forest-chart"),rows,{log:true,ref:1,xTitle:"Incidence-rate ratio per SD of host-vocabulary share (log scale)",title:"Forest plot of host-vocabulary and co-transfer effects",rowH:30});
  $("#forest-legend").innerHTML=`<span><span class="sw" style="background:#0a5ea8"></span>OpenAlex main-arm folds</span><span><span class="sw" style="background:#1b7f5a"></span>MeSH replication</span>${spec==="co"?'<span><span class="sw" style="background:#c26a00"></span>IVW pooled</span>':""}${ct?'<span><span class="sw" style="background:#8a909b"></span>co-transfer (competing channel)</span>':""}<span>dashed line: IRR = 1, no effect</span>`;
  const sel=FOREST.rows.filter(r=>r.spec===spec);
  const sig=sel.filter(r=>r.lo>1).map(r=>r.fold), nul=sel.filter(r=>r.lo<=1);
  const ctSig=sel.filter(r=>r.ct_lo>1||r.ct_hi<1).length;
  let t;
  if(spec==="co") t=`Under the co-primary specification the host-share interval sits above 1 on all ${sig.length} folds (${sel.map(r=>r.fold+" "+f2(r.irr)).join(", ")}), and the pooled estimate is ${f2(ivw.irr)}. `;
  else t=`Under the strict primary specification the interval clears 1 only on ${sig.join(" and ")||"no fold"}; ${nul.map(r=>`${r.fold} (${f2(r.irr)}, ${r.G} clusters, ${nf(r.N)} of the events)`).join(" and ")} ${nul.length===1?"is":"are"} inconclusive. `;
  t+= ct?`Co-transfer intervals include 1 on ${sel.length-ctSig} of ${sel.length} folds.`:`Tick "Show co-transfer" to compare the competing channel.`;
  $("#forest-take").textContent=t;
}
$$('input[name=spec]').forEach(r=>r.addEventListener("change",drawForest)); $("#show-ct").addEventListener("change",drawForest);

/* ========== 2. Stepper ========== */
const S=STEP, zA=(S.A_cont-S.mean_A)/S.sd_A;
const STAGES=[
 {k:"Pool",t:"1. The concept enters the outcome-blind pool",
  in:`OpenAlex titles and abstracts; the noun phrase "${S.concept}".`,
  do:`Frame frozen and hashed before any later data were read. The phrase first appears with at least 5 papers in ${S.F}.`,
  out:`A yearly work count from ${S.F} to 2024 (chart below): ${S.counts[S.F]} papers in ${S.F}, ${S.counts["2024"]} in 2024.`,
  why:"Selecting concepts before seeing their fate stops the study from sampling only the successes.", chart:"counts"},
 {k:"Entry",t:"2. A host-entry event is detected",
  in:`The concept's works tagged by OpenAlex subfield. Origin subfield: ${S.origin}.`,
  do:"Find the first year the concept appears in a non-origin subfield with at least five co-occurring partner terms.",
  out:`Entry into ${S.host} in ${S.e}: ${S.n_entry_papers} entry-year papers, ${S.n_partners} distinct partner terms. This concept has ${S.n_host_entries_concept} such entries in the Screen sample.`,
  why:"The unit is the entry, not the concept, so one concept can take root in one host and fade in another."},
 {k:"Partners",t:"3. Each partner is profiled by where it is used",
  in:`The ${S.n_partners} partner terms and their exact OpenAlex subfield-by-period publication counts (profiles cover ${pct(S.cov)} of this entry's partner tags).`,
  do:"For each partner, compute its pre-entry share of papers in the host subfield; mark whether it was an origin companion in the previous five years.",
  out:`At a 0.3 host-share cut, ${pct(S.graft)} of tags are host-native grafts, ${pct(S.package)} are origin companions and ${pct(S.third_party)} are other non-native terms.`,
  why:"Across the Screen fold only 1.1% of partner tags have a host share above 50%, so the continuous share is used rather than a native / non-native cut.", chart:"parts"},
 {k:"Share",t:"4. Exposure: host-vocabulary share and co-transfer",
  in:"Partner host shares, weighted by association strength.",
  do:"Average them into the host-vocabulary share; separately, count the fraction of partners that were origin companions (co-transfer).",
  out:`Host-vocabulary share ${f3(S.A_cont)}, which is ${f1(zA)} SD above the Screen mean of ${f3(S.mean_A)} (SD ${f3(S.sd_A)}). Co-transfer ${f2(S.CT)}.`,
  why:"This entry is unusual: it arrives with host vocabulary and none of its origin companions.", chart:"share"},
 {k:"Uptake",t:"5. Outcome: newcomer uptake over five years",
  in:"All concept papers in the host subfield in the five years after entry, with author lists.",
  do:"Keep papers whose authors had no prior concept paper and no co-authorship with concept authors.",
  out:`${S.Y} newcomer papers (${S.Y_all} host papers in total). The entry counts as rooted: at least five newcomer papers in at least three of the five years.`,
  why:"Counting only newcomers separates spread to new people from the original team continuing in a new venue."},
 {k:"Model",t:"6. Model: PPML across all entries",
  in:"1,544 Screen entries with fixed effects for concept, entry year and host (co-primary).",
  do:"Regress newcomer papers on host-vocabulary share and co-transfer with concept-clustered standard errors; also fit out-of-fold predictions with and without the two exposures.",
  out:`Screen co-primary IRR ${f2(S.irr)} per SD. For this entry the controls-only model predicts ${f1(S.pb)} newcomer papers and the model with host share predicts ${f1(S.pm)}; ${S.Y} were observed.`,
  why:"Fixed effects compare entries of the same concept against each other, so a concept's general popularity cannot drive the estimate.", chart:"pred"}
];
let cur=0;
function drawPipe(){
  const c=$("#pipe"); const W=cw(c), H=78; const svg=newSvg(c,W,H,"Pipeline of the host-entry method");
  const n=STAGES.length, pad=26, step=(W-2*pad)/(n-1);
  el("line",{x1:pad,x2:W-pad,y1:24,y2:24,stroke:"#c9ccd1","stroke-width":2},svg);
  el("line",{x1:pad,x2:pad+cur*step,y1:24,y2:24,stroke:"var(--accent)","stroke-width":3},svg);
  STAGES.forEach((s,i)=>{
    const g=el("g",{class:"node"+(i<cur?" done":""),tabindex:"0",role:"button","aria-label":`Stage ${i+1}: ${s.t.replace(/^\d\.\s*/,"")}`},svg);
    if(i===cur) g.setAttribute("aria-current","step");
    el("circle",{cx:pad+i*step,cy:24,r:15},g);
    el("text",{x:pad+i*step,y:29,"text-anchor":"middle",class:"n","font-size":14,"font-weight":700},g,String(i+1));
    el("text",{x:pad+i*step,y:62,"text-anchor":"middle",class:"tick","font-weight":i===cur?700:400},g,s.k);
    g.addEventListener("click",()=>go(i)); g.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Enter"||e.key===" "){e.preventDefault();go(i);}});
  });
}
function drawStageChart(){
  const s=STAGES[cur], c=$("#st-chart");
  if(!s.chart){c.innerHTML="";return;}
  if(s.chart==="counts"){
    const yrs=Object.keys(S.counts).filter(y=>+y>=S.F-2);
    barChart(c,yrs.map(y=>({label:"'"+y.slice(2),value:S.counts[y],color:+y===S.e?"#c26a00":"#0a5ea8",valText:"",tipHtml:`<b>${y}</b>: ${S.counts[y]} concept works${+y===S.e?" (entry year into "+esc(S.host)+")":""}`,aria:`${y}: ${S.counts[y]} works`})),{yTitle:"Works per year",H:200,title:"Yearly works for the concept"});
  } else if(s.chart==="parts"){
    const parts=[["Host-native grafts",S.graft,"#1b7f5a"],["Origin companions",S.package,"#56b4e9"],["Native companions",S.native_companion,"#0a5ea8"],["Other non-native",S.third_party,"#9aa0a8"]];
    barChart(c,parts.map(p=>({label:p[0].replace(" ","\n"),value:p[1]*100,color:p[2],valText:pct(p[1]),tipHtml:`<b>${p[0]}</b>: ${pct(p[1])} of partner tags`,aria:`${p[0]} ${pct(p[1])}`})),{yTitle:"Share of partner tags (%)",H:210,minMax:10,title:"Partner partition"});
  } else if(s.chart==="share"){
    const scr=EV.screen.map(e=>e.A).sort((a,b)=>a-b), rank=scr.filter(a=>a<S.A_cont).length/scr.length;
    intervalChart(c,[{label:"This entry",est:S.A_cont,lo:S.A_cont,hi:S.A_cont,color:"#c26a00",bold:true,valText:f3(S.A_cont),tipHtml:`This entry: ${f3(S.A_cont)}, higher than ${pct(rank)} of Screen entries`,aria:"This entry host share"},
      {label:"Screen mean ± 1 SD",est:S.mean_A,lo:Math.max(0,S.mean_A-S.sd_A),hi:S.mean_A+S.sd_A,color:"#9aa0a8",valText:`${f3(S.mean_A)} (SD ${f3(S.sd_A)})`,tipHtml:`Screen fold host-vocabulary share: mean ${f3(S.mean_A)}, SD ${f3(S.sd_A)} (lower whisker truncated at 0)`,aria:"Screen mean"}],
      {ref:0,xTitle:"Host-vocabulary share (fraction)",rowH:34,title:"Host share of this entry versus the Screen fold"});
  } else if(s.chart==="pred"){
    barChart(c,[["Controls-only\nprediction",S.pb,"#9aa0a8"],["With host share\nprediction",S.pm,"#0a5ea8"],["Observed",S.Y,"#c26a00"]].map(p=>({label:p[0],value:p[1],color:p[2],valText:p[0].startsWith("Obs")?String(p[1]):f1(p[1]),tipHtml:`<b>${p[0].replace("\n"," ")}</b>: ${p[0].startsWith("Obs")?p[1]:f1(p[1])} newcomer papers`,aria:`${p[0]} ${p[1]}`})),{yTitle:"Newcomer papers",H:220,title:"Predictions versus observed"});
  }
}
function go(i){
  cur=Math.max(0,Math.min(STAGES.length-1,i)); const s=STAGES[cur];
  $("#stage-title").textContent=s.t; $("#st-in").textContent=s.in; $("#st-do").textContent=s.do; $("#st-out").textContent=s.out; $("#st-why").textContent="Why: "+s.why;
  $("#st-prev").disabled=cur===0; $("#st-next").disabled=cur===STAGES.length-1;
  $("#st-live").textContent=`Stage ${cur+1} of ${STAGES.length}: ${s.t.replace(/^\d\.\s*/,"")}`;
  $("#st-take").textContent=cur<STAGES.length-1?`Stage ${cur+1} of ${STAGES.length} for "${S.concept}" entering ${S.host} in ${S.e}.`:`This one entry had a host share ${f1(zA)} SD above the mean and drew ${S.Y} newcomer papers; the host-share model moved its prediction from ${f1(S.pb)} to ${f1(S.pm)}, closer to what happened.`;
  drawPipe(); drawStageChart();
}
$("#st-prev").addEventListener("click",()=>go(cur-1)); $("#st-next").addEventListener("click",()=>go(cur+1));
$("#v-stepper").addEventListener("keydown",e=>{ if(e.target.matches("input,select,textarea"))return; if(e.key==="ArrowRight"){go(cur+1);e.preventDefault();} if(e.key==="ArrowLeft"){go(cur-1);e.preventDefault();} });

/* ========== 3. Event browser ========== */
let bSel=null;
function bRows(){
  const f=$("#b-fold").value, q=$("#b-q").value.trim().toLowerCase(), filt=$('input[name=bfilt]:checked').value;
  const all=EV[f]; const hiCut=quantile(all.map(e=>e.A),0.8);
  let r=all.filter(e=>!q||e.concept.toLowerCase().includes(q)||e.host.toLowerCase().includes(q)||e.origin.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  if(filt==="up") r=r.filter(e=>e.Y>=1); if(filt==="none") r=r.filter(e=>e.Y===0); if(filt==="fail") r=r.filter(e=>e.Y===0&&e.A>=hiCut);
  const s=$("#b-sort").value;
  const err=e=>Math.abs(e.Y-e.pb)-Math.abs(e.Y-e.pm);
  r.sort((a,b)=> s==="A"?b.A-a.A : s==="Y"?b.Y-a.Y||b.A-a.A : s==="gain"?err(b)-err(a) : err(a)-err(b));
  return {all,r,hiCut,filt,f,q};
}
function quantile(arr,p){const s=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b);return s[Math.floor(p*(s.length-1))];}
function drawBrowser(keepSel){
  const {all,r,hiCut,filt,f}=bRows();
  if(!keepSel||!bSel||bSel.f!==f||!r.includes(bSel.e)) bSel=r.length?{f,e:r[0]}:null;
  const L=$("#b-list"); L.innerHTML="";
  r.slice(0,150).forEach(e=>{
    const b=document.createElement("button"); b.type="button"; b.setAttribute("role","option");
    b.setAttribute("aria-selected",bSel&&bSel.e===e?"true":"false");
    b.innerHTML=`<span>${esc(e.concept)}</span><span class="num">share ${f3(e.A)} · ${e.Y} new</span><span class="sub">${esc(e.origin)} → ${esc(e.host)}, ${e.e}</span>`;
    b.addEventListener("click",()=>{bSel={f,e};drawBrowser(true);});
    b.addEventListener("keydown",ev=>{ if(ev.key==="ArrowDown"||ev.key==="ArrowUp"){ev.preventDefault(); const sib=ev.key==="ArrowDown"?b.nextElementSibling:b.previousElementSibling; if(sib){sib.click(); setTimeout(()=>{const s2=L.querySelector('[aria-selected=true]'); if(s2) s2.focus();},0);} } });
    L.appendChild(b);
  });
  const nUp=r.filter(e=>e.Y>=1).length;
  $("#b-count").textContent=`${nf(r.length)} of ${nf(all.length)} ${FOLDNAME[f]} entries match; ${nf(nUp)} of them had any newcomer uptake.${filt==="fail"?` "High share" means a share of at least ${f3(hiCut)}, the top fifth of this fold.`:""}`;
  drawScatter(all,new Set(r));
  drawDetail();
  const sel=L.querySelector('[aria-selected=true]'); if(sel&&keepSel) sel.scrollIntoView({block:"nearest"});
  // takeaway
  if(!r.length){$("#b-take").textContent="No entries match this filter.";return;}
  const gainN=r.filter(e=>Math.abs(e.Y-e.pm)<Math.abs(e.Y-e.pb)).length;
  let t=`Among these ${nf(r.length)} entries, the model with host share is closer to the observed count than the controls-only model for ${pct(gainN/r.length)} of them. `;
  if(filt==="fail") t+=`These are the entries that had host vocabulary and still drew no newcomers: the effect shifts the odds, it does not guarantee rooting.`;
  else if(filt==="none") t+=`Most entries with no uptake have low host share; the median here is ${f3(quantile(r.map(e=>e.A),0.5))} against ${f3(quantile(all.map(e=>e.A),0.5))} for the fold.`;
  else if(filt==="up") t+=`Their median host share is ${f3(quantile(r.map(e=>e.A),0.5))}, against ${f3(quantile(all.map(e=>e.A),0.5))} for the whole fold.`;
  else t+=`Select an entry to put its inputs beside both predictions.`;
  $("#b-take").textContent=t;
}
function drawScatter(all,inSet){
  const c=$("#b-scatter"); const W=cw(c), H=280; const svg=newSvg(c,W,H,"Host-vocabulary share against newcomer papers");
  const maxA=Math.max(...all.map(e=>e.A)), maxY=Math.max(...all.map(e=>e.Y));
  const yT=[0,1,3,10,30,100,300,1000].filter(v=>v<=maxY*1.5||v===0);
  const tw=textW(svg,yT.map(String),"tick");
  const L=tw+38, R=W-12, T=10, B=H-44;
  const X=a=>L+a/(maxA*1.04)*(R-L), Y=y=>B-Math.log1p(y)/Math.log1p(maxY*1.1)*(B-T);
  niceTicksLin(0,maxA*1.04,5).forEach(t=>{el("line",{x1:X(t),x2:X(t),y1:T,y2:B,class:"gl"},svg);el("text",{x:X(t),y:B+16,"text-anchor":"middle",class:"tick"},svg,String(+t.toFixed(3)));});
  yT.forEach(t=>{el("line",{x1:L,x2:R,y1:Y(t),y2:Y(t),class:"gl"},svg);el("text",{x:L-6,y:Y(t)+4,"text-anchor":"end",class:"tick"},svg,String(t));});
  el("text",{x:(L+R)/2,y:H-6,"text-anchor":"middle",class:"axt"},svg,"Host-vocabulary share (fraction)");
  el("text",{transform:`translate(13,${(T+B)/2}) rotate(-90)`,"text-anchor":"middle",class:"axt"},svg,"Newcomer papers (log scale)");
  const gOut=el("g",{},svg), gIn=el("g",{},svg);
  all.forEach(e=>{
    const inn=inSet.has(e);
    const cc=el("circle",{cx:X(e.A),cy:Y(e.Y),r:inn?3.2:2.4,fill:inn?"#0a5ea8":"#d6d8db","fill-opacity":inn?0.45:0.8},inn?gIn:gOut);
    cc.addEventListener("mouseenter",ev=>showTip(`<b>${esc(e.concept)}</b><br>${esc(e.host)}, ${e.e}<br>share ${f3(e.A)}, ${e.Y} newcomer papers`,cc,ev));
    cc.addEventListener("mouseleave",hideTip);
    cc.addEventListener("click",ev=>{ev.stopPropagation(); if(inn){bSel={f:$("#b-fold").value,e};drawBrowser(true);} showTip(`<b>${esc(e.concept)}</b><br>${esc(e.host)}, ${e.e}<br>share ${f3(e.A)}, ${e.Y} newcomer papers${inn?"":"<br>(outside current filter)"}`,cc,ev);});
    cc.style.cursor="pointer";
  });
  if(bSel){const e=bSel.e; el("circle",{cx:X(e.A),cy:Y(e.Y),r:8,fill:"none",stroke:"#d97706","stroke-width":3},svg); el("circle",{cx:X(e.A),cy:Y(e.Y),r:3.5,fill:"#d97706"},svg);}
}
function drawDetail(){
  const d=$("#b-detail"); if(!bSel){d.innerHTML="";return;} const e=bSel.e;
  const better=Math.abs(e.Y-e.pm)<Math.abs(e.Y-e.pb)?"method":(Math.abs(e.Y-e.pm)>Math.abs(e.Y-e.pb)?"baseline":"tie");
  d.innerHTML=`<div><h4>Input: the entry</h4><dl>
    <dt>Concept</dt><dd style="font-family:inherit">${esc(e.concept)}</dd>
    <dt>Origin</dt><dd style="font-family:inherit">${esc(e.origin)}</dd><dt>Host</dt><dd style="font-family:inherit">${esc(e.host)}</dd>
    <dt>Entry year</dt><dd>${e.e}</dd><dt>Entry papers</dt><dd>${e.nep}</dd>${e.np!=null?`<dt>Partners</dt><dd>${e.np}</dd>`:""}
    <dt>Host share</dt><dd>${f3(e.A)}</dd><dt>Co-transfer</dt><dd>${f2(e.CT)}</dd></dl></div>
  <div><h4>Predictions (out of fold)</h4><dl>
    <dt>Controls only</dt><dd>${f2(e.pb)}</dd><dt>+ host share, co-transfer</dt><dd>${f2(e.pm)}</dd></dl>
    <p class="note" style="margin:8px 0 0">${e.pm>e.pb?"Adding the exposures raised":"Adding the exposures lowered"} the prediction by ${f2(Math.abs(e.pm-e.pb))}.</p></div>
  <div><h4>Observed outcome</h4><dl><dt>Newcomer papers</dt><dd>${e.Y}</dd></dl>
    <p class="note" style="margin:8px 0 0">${better==="method"?"The host-share model is closer to what happened.":better==="baseline"?"The controls-only model is closer here.":"Both predictions are equally far off."}</p></div>`;
}
["#b-fold","#b-sort"].forEach(s=>$(s).addEventListener("change",()=>drawBrowser(false)));
$("#b-q").addEventListener("input",()=>drawBrowser(false));
$$('input[name=bfilt]').forEach(r=>r.addEventListener("change",()=>drawBrowser(false)));

/* ========== 4. Mechanism tabs ========== */
let mTab="ext";
function drawMech(){
  const c=$("#mech-chart");
  const FL={SCREEN:"Screen",HELDOUT:"Held-out",MESH:"MeSH",IVW:"IVW pooled"};
  if(mTab==="ext"||mTab==="int"){
    const test=mTab==="ext"?"K1a_LPM":"K1b", ivwT=mTab==="ext"?"K1f_IVW_K1a_LPM_pp_per_sd":"K1f_IVW_K1b_log_irr_per_sd";
    const rs=MECH.margins.filter(m=>m.test===test).concat(MECH.margins.filter(m=>m.test===ivwT));
    const fm=mTab==="ext"?f2:f3;
    intervalChart(c,rs.map(m=>({label:FL[m.fold]||m.fold,est:m.est,lo:m.lo,hi:m.hi,color:m.fold==="IVW"?"#c4471d":"#0a5ea8",shape:m.fold==="IVW"?"diamond":"circle",bold:m.fold==="IVW",group:m.fold==="IVW",
      valText:`${fm(m.est)} [${fm(m.lo)}, ${fm(m.hi)}]`,

function wireTabs(list,onSel){
  const tabs=Array.from(list.querySelectorAll("[role=tab]"));

    t.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{let j=null; if(e.key==="ArrowRight")j=(i+1)%tabs.length; if(e.key==="ArrowLeft")j=(i-1+tabs.length)%tabs.length; if(e.key==="Home")j=0; if(e.key==="End")j=tabs.length-1; if(j!=null){e.preventDefault();sel(j);tabs[j].focus();}});
  });
  function sel(i){tabs.forEach((t,j)=>{t.setAttribute("aria-selected",j===i?"true":"false");t.tabIndex=j===i?0:-1;}); onSel(tabs[i],i);}
}

function drawCase(){

  const meanNon=non.length?non.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.A,0)/non.length:null;
  const c=$("#case-chart"); const W=cw(c), rowH=26, T=10, B=46, H=T+B+rs.length*rowH;
  const svg=newSvg(c,W,H,"Host entries of "+name);
  const labs=rs.map(r=>`${r.host}, ${r.e}`);
  const L=Math.min(textW(svg,labs,"lab")+12,W*0.5), vw=textW(svg,rs.map(r=>r.rooted?`${f3(r.A)} · ${r.Y} new`:f3(r.A)),"val")+10, R=W-vw-8;
  const maxA=Math.max(0.15,...rs.map(r=>r.A));
  const X=a=>L+a/maxA*(R-L);
  niceTicksLin(0,maxA,5).forEach(t=>{el("line",{x1:X(t),x2:X(t),y1:T,y2:H-B,class:"gl"},svg);el("text",{x:X(t),y:H-B+16,"text-anchor":"middle",class:"tick"},svg,String(+t.toFixed(3)));});
  el("text",{x:(L+R)/2,y:H-8,"text-anchor":"middle",class:"axt"},svg,"Host-vocabulary share (fraction)");
  rs.forEach((r,i)=>{
    const y=T+i*rowH;
    el("text",{x:L-8,y:y+rowH/2+4,"text-anchor":"end",class:"lab","font-weight":r.rooted?700:400},svg,labs[i]);
    const g=el("g",{},svg);
    el("rect",{x:L,y:y+4,width:Math.max(1,X(r.A)-L),height:rowH-8,fill:r.rooted?"#1b7f5a":"#9aa0a8",class:"hl",rx:2},g);
    el("text",{x:X(r.A)+6,y:y+rowH/2+4,class:"val"},svg,r.rooted?`${f3(r.A)} · ${r.Y} new`:f3(r.A));
    markify(g,`<b>${esc(r.host)}, ${r.e}</b><br>host share ${f3(r.A)}, co-transfer ${f2(r.CT)}<br>${r.Y} newcomer papers; ${r.rooted?"rooted":"not rooted"}`,`${r.host} ${r.e}, share ${f3(r.A)}, ${r.rooted?"rooted":"not rooted"}`);
  });

  else if(root.length) t=`A single co-primary entry, rooted at share ${f3(root[0].A)}, so there is no within-concept contrast: rooting without broad occupancy.`;
  else t=`No entry took root. The non-rooted mean share is ${f3(meanNon)}, and ${non.filter(r=>r.CT>=0.999).length} of ${non.length} entries arrived as pure origin packages (co-transfer 1.0). The highest-share entry (${rs[0].host}, ${f3(rs[0].A)}) still did not take root.`;

/* ========== 6. Closure ========== */
function drawClosure(){

    const col=r.key==="constraint"?"#c26a00":r.decision==="CONFIRMED"?"#0a5ea8":"#9aa0a8";
    const fmt=(r.key==="constraint"&&k==="es_ho")?f3:f2;
    return {label:r.label,est,lo,hi,color:col,bold:r.decision==="CONFIRMED",
      valText:`${fmt(est)} [${fmt(lo)}, ${fmt(hi)}]${k!=="es_screen"&&r.holm!=null?"  Holm "+fp(r.holm):""}`,
      tipHtml:`<b>${r.label}</b><br>${fmt(est)}, 95% CI ${fmt(lo)} to ${fmt(hi)}${r.holm!=null?`<br>Holm p (Held-out panel) ${fp(r.holm)}`:""}${r.panel_screen!=null?`<br>Screen panel coefficient ${f2(r.panel_screen)}`:""}`,
      aria:`${r.label} ${fmt(est)}`};});
  intervalChart($("#c-chart"),rs,{ref:0,xTitle:k==="panel_ho"?"Panel coefficient":"Standardised mean difference, S",title:"Closure measures before sustained uptake"});
  const p=CLOS.find(r=>r.key==="closure_persist"), g=CLOS.find(r=>r.key==="closure"), b=CLOS.find(r=>r.key==="constraint");
  $("#c-note").innerHTML=`Concepts with <button class="term" type="button" data-term="sust">sustained uptake</button> against matched controls, lags -3 to 0. Holm p applies to the Held-out panel coefficient. ${k==="es_ho"?"Burt constraint is shown at three decimals: the source value is "+f3(b.es_ho[0])+", which the paper rounds to +0.11.":""}`;
  addTerms($("#c-note"));
  const cur=rs.find(r=>r.label===p.label);
  $("#c-take").textContent=k==="es_screen"?`On the Screen fold general closure is already lower before uptake (S ${f2(g.es_screen[0])}, 95% CI ${f2(g.es_screen[1])} to ${f2(g.es_screen[2])}), opposite to the pre-registered positive sign; the Held-out view shows which measures survive.`
    :`On the Held-out fold only persistent-neighbour closure survives Holm correction (panel ${f2(p.panel_ho[0])}, Holm p ${fp(p.holm)}); general closure does not (Holm p ${fp(g.holm)}). Burt constraint is positive, so this is not brokerage: the ego network is more redundant, not less.`;
}
$("#c-est").addEventListener("change",drawClosure);

/* ========== 7. What-if ========== */

  const all=EV[f]; const hiG=all.filter(e=>e.A>=tau), loG=all.filter(e=>e.A<tau);

    {label:`share < ${tau.toFixed(3)}\n(n = ${nf(loG.length)})`,value:rl*100,color:"#9aa0a8",valText:(rl*100).toFixed(1)+"%",tipHtml:`<b>Share below ${tau.toFixed(3)}</b><br>${nf(loG.filter(e=>e.Y>=k).length)} of ${nf(loG.length)} entries reached ≥ ${k} newcomer papers`,aria:`below threshold ${(rl*100).toFixed(1)} percent`},
    {label:`share ≥ ${tau.toFixed(3)}\n(n = ${nf(hiG.length)})`,value:rh*100,color:"#0a5ea8",valText:(rh*100).toFixed(1)+"%",tipHtml:`<b>Share at or above ${tau.toFixed(3)}</b><br>${nf(hiG.filter(e=>e.Y>=k).length)} of ${nf(hiG.length)} entries reached ≥ ${k} newcomer papers`,aria:`above threshold ${(rh*100).toFixed(1)} percent`}

  $("#w-take").textContent=t;
}

content</a>\n<div id=\"tip\" role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"></div>\n<header class=\"top\">\n  <div class=\"wrap\">\n    <p class=\"kicker\">Interactive companion to the paper</p>\n    <h1>Host vocabulary predicts whether new scientific concepts take root across disciplinary boundaries</h1>\n    <p class=\"byline\">The paper carries no author line. Data: 426 emerging concepts, 462,812 OpenAlex works and 191 MeSH biomedical concepts.</p>\n    <div class=\"links\">\n      <a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_F1tk5OGtH84L/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_F1tk5OGtH84L/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new/tree/fork/run_F1tk5OGtH84L\">Code repository</a>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</header>\n<nav class=\"secnav\" aria-label=\"Sections\">\n  <ul>\n    <li><a href=\"#finding\">The finding</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#how\">How it works</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#evidence\">Explore the evidence</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#try\">Try it</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#fails\">Where it fails</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#notes\">Glossary and sources</a></li>\n  </ul>\n</nav>\n<main id=\"main\">\n\n<section class=\"sec\" id=\"finding\" aria-labelledby=\"h-finding\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-finding\">The finding</h2>\n  <div class=\"grid2\">\n    <div class=\"prose\">\n      <p class=\"lede\">When a scientific concept first shows up in a new subfield, most such entries fade. Which ones take root?</p>\n      <p>The paper looks at the first papers that carry a concept into a non-origin subfield, a <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"entry\">host-entry event</button>, and asks what share of the concept's co-occurring partner terms already belong to the host's own vocabulary. That <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"share\">host-vocabulary share</button> predicts how many papers <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"newcomer\">newcomer authors</button> in the host write about the concept over the next five years.</p>\n      <p>On the independent <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"mesh\">MeSH</button> biomedical population, one standard deviation more host vocabulary raises newcomer uptake by</p>\n      <p class=\"bignum\" id=\"big-num\" aria-describedby=\"big-cap\"></p>\n      <p id=\"big-cap\" class=\"note\"></p>\n      <p>The competing explanation, that concepts take root when they arrive with their old companions (<button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"ct\">co-transfer</button>), is null on every fold.</p>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-forest\">\n      <p class=\"vq\">Does the host-vocabulary effect hold on every fold, and under both fixed-effects specifications?</p>\n      <div class=\"controls\">\n        <fieldset>\n          <legend>Specification</legend>\n          <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Specification\">\n            <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"spec\" value=\"co\" checked><span>Co-primary</span></label>\n            <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"spec\" value=\"pri\"><span>Primary (strict FE)</span></label>\n          </div>\n        </fieldset>\n        <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"show-ct\" checked> Show co-transfer</label>\n      </div>\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"forest-chart\"></div>\n      <div class=\"legend\" id=\"forest-legend\"></div>\n      <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"forest-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<section class=\"sec\" id=\"how\" aria-labelledby=\"h-how\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-how\">How it works</h2>\n  <p class=\"prose\">The study has four stages: an outcome-blind concept pool, yearly co-word networks, a matched event study of emergence (RQ1) and the host-entry test (RQ2). The stepper below follows one real host entry from the data through the RQ2 pipeline, with the values the run recorded at each stage.</p>\n  <figure>\n    <img src=\"figures/fig1_v0.jpg\" alt=\"Four-panel study design: (a) an arXiv concept pool of 426 concepts split into a screen fold of 247 and a held-out fold of 119, plus a MeSH check population of 191, all drawn from 462,812 OpenAlex works; (b) a co-word network with three Leiden communities; (c) a schematic matched event study comparing a concept with sustained uptake against a flat control around onset; (d) a schematic of a concept moving from an origin subfield into a host subfield, with host-native and origin partners and a host-vocabulary share predicting five-year newcomer uptake.\" loading=\"lazy\" width=\"3840\" height=\"1648\">\n    <figcaption>Overview of the study design. (a) Data: an outcome-blind arXiv concept pool of 426 emerging scientific concepts, split into a screen fold (247) and a held-out fold (119), and an independent MeSH biomedical check population of 191 concepts. Both are drawn from 462,812 OpenAlex works. (b) Co-word network: yearly co-word snapshots (25 snapshots, ~27k nodes, ~84k edges) with Leiden communities; the schematic shows three colour-coded communities. (c) RQ1, emergence precursors: a matched event study compares closure measures in the pre-onset window (shaded) between concepts showing sustained uptake (blue, rising after onset) and controls (grey, flat). (d) RQ2, host-entry grafting: a concept enters a non-origin host subfield (light blue → light green region). Its partner terms are either host-native (dark green) or from the origin vocabulary (light blue). The host-vocabulary share (orange) is the exposure in a pre-registered PPML regression with concept-clustered standard errors predicting 5-year newcomer uptake. The timelines and bars in (c) and (d) are schematic and carry no data values.</figcaption>\n  </figure>\n  <div class=\"view stepper\" id=\"v-stepper\">\n    <p class=\"vq\">What happens to one concept entry, stage by stage?</p>\n    <div class=\"chart pipe\" id=\"pipe\" aria-label=\"Pipeline stages\"></div>\n    <h3 id=\"stage-title\" style=\"margin-top:14px\"></h3>\n    <div class=\"stagebox\">\n      <div><h4>What goes in</h4><p id=\"st-in\"></p></div>\n      <div><h4>What is done</h4><p id=\"st-do\"></p></div>\n      <div><h4>What comes out</h4><p id=\"st-out\"></p></div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"st-chart\"></div>\n    <p class=\"why\" id=\"st-why\"></p>\n    <div class=\"stepnav\">\n      <button type=\"button\" id=\"st-prev\">Previous</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" id=\"st-next\">Next</button>\n      <span class=\"note\">Left and right arrow keys also move between stages when the stepper has focus.</span>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"vh\" id=\"st-live\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"st-take\"></p>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<section class=\"sec\" id=\"evidence\" aria-labelledby=\"h-evidence\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-evidence\">Explore the evidence</h2>\n  <p class=\"prose\">Every host-entry event behind the three regressions is embedded below: 1,740 Screen events, 1,097 Held-out events and 2,249 MeSH events, each with its recorded host-vocabulary share, its co-transfer, its observed newcomer uptake and two out-of-fold predictions, one from a controls-only model and one that adds host-vocabulary share and co-transfer.</p>\n\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-browser\">\n    <p class=\"vq\">What does a single entry look like, and did the host-share model predict it better than the controls-only model?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <label>Fold <select id=\"b-fold\"><option value=\"screen\">Screen (1,740)</option><option value=\"heldout\">Held-out (1,097)</option><option value=\"mesh\">MeSH (2,249)</option></select></label>\n      <label>Search concept or host <input type=\"search\" id=\"b-q\" placeholder=\"e.g. steering, Optics\"></label>\n      <label>Sort <select id=\"b-sort\"><option value=\"A\">Host-vocabulary share, high first</option><option value=\"Y\">Newcomer papers, most first</option><option value=\"gain\">Largest gain over baseline</option><option value=\"loss\">Largest loss vs baseline</option></select></label>\n    </div>\n    <fieldset class=\"controls\">\n      <legend>Show</legend>\n      <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Filter entries\">\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"bfilt\" value=\"all\" checked><span>All entries</span></label>\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"bfilt\" value=\"up\"><span>Any uptake</span></label>\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"bfilt\" value=\"none\"><span>No uptake</span></label>\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"bfilt\" value=\"fail\"><span>High share, no uptake</span></label>\n      </div>\n    </fieldset>\n    <p class=\"count\" id=\"b-count\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <div class=\"browser\">\n      <div>\n        <div class=\"list\" id=\"b-list\" role=\"listbox\" aria-label=\"Host-entry events\"></div>\n        <p class=\"note\">The list shows the first 150 matches in the chosen order.</p>\n      </div>\n      <div>\n        <div class=\"chart\" id=\"b-scatter\"></div>\n        <div class=\"legend\"><span><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent);opacity:.55\"></span>entry in current filter</span><span><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:#d6d8db\"></span>other entries in fold</span><span><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--focus)\"></span>selected entry</span></div>\n        <div class=\"detail\" id=\"b-detail\"></div>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"b-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-mech\">\n    <p class=\"vq\">Does host vocabulary start uptake, grow it, or both? And who adopts?</p>\n    <div class=\"tabs\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Mechanism view\">\n      <button role=\"tab\" id=\"tab-ext\" aria-selected=\"true\" aria-controls=\"mech-panel\" data-m=\"ext\">Extensive margin</button>\n      <button role=\"tab\" id=\"tab-int\" aria-selected=\"false\" aria-controls=\"mech-panel\" data-m=\"int\" tabindex=\"-1\">Intensive margin</button>\n      <button role=\"tab\" id=\"tab-ad\" aria-selected=\"false\" aria-controls=\"mech-panel\" data-m=\"ad\" tabindex=\"-1\">Adopters</button>\n    </div>\n    <div id=\"mech-panel\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"tab-ext\">\n      <p class=\"note\" id=\"mech-note\"></p>\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"mech-chart\"></div>\n      <div class=\"legend\" id=\"mech-legend\"></div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"mech-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-cases\">\n    <p class=\"vq\">Within one concept, does the entry that took root have the highest host-vocabulary share?</p>\n    <div class=\"tabs\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Representative concept\" id=\"case-tabs\"></div>\n    <div id=\"case-panel\" role=\"tabpanel\">\n      <p class=\"note\" id=\"case-note\"></p>\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"case-chart\"></div>\n      <div class=\"legend\"><span><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--green)\"></span><button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"rooted\">rooted</button> entry</span><span><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></span>non-rooted entry</span><span><span class=\"sw\" style=\"border:2px dashed var(--ink2);background:none\"></span>mean share of non-rooted entries</span></div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"case-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-closure\">\n    <p class=\"vq\">RQ1: what does a concept's network neighbourhood look like before sustained uptake?</p>\n    <div class=\"grid2\">\n      <div>\n        <div class=\"controls\">\n          <label>Estimate <select id=\"c-est\">\n            <option value=\"es_ho\">Held-out, matched event study (S, 95% CI)</option>\n            <option value=\"panel_ho\">Held-out, panel coefficient (95% CI)</option>\n            <option value=\"es_screen\">Screen, matched event study (S, 95% CI)</option>\n          </select></label>\n        </div>\n        <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-chart\"></div>\n        <div class=\"legend\"><span><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></span>survives Holm correction</span><span><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></span>not confirmed</span><span><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--orange)\"></span>Burt constraint</span></div>\n        <p class=\"note\" id=\"c-note\"></p>\n      </div>\n      <figure style=\"margin-top:0\">\n        <img src=\"figures/fig2_v0.jpg\" alt=\"Schematic co-word network with six coloured Leiden communities of background terms; bold-ringed pool concepts, including wireless backhaul, EPR steering and holographic QCD, sit on community edges between two communities.\" loading=\"lazy\" width=\"3312\" height=\"2480\">\n        <figcaption>Schematic co-word network snapshot (2012, three-year window). Nodes are concept-keyword terms and grey edges are association-strength weighted co-occurrences; node fill colour (blue, green, orange, purple, red, teal) marks Leiden community membership, and larger circles are high-degree hub terms. Background terms (plain nodes) form dense communities that are joined by only a few inter-community edges. Pool concepts (bold black rings) sit on the periphery of communities, mostly in the gaps between two of them, where they act as bridge or connector nodes; three are labelled as examples (wireless backhaul, EPR steering, holographic QCD). The full network comprises approximately 27,000 nodes and 84,000 edges; the panel is an illustrative rendering of its high-degree core for readability.</figcaption>\n      </figure>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"c-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<section class=\"sec\" id=\"try\" aria-labelledby=\"h-try\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-try\">Try it: set your own bar for \"took root\"</h2>\n  <p class=\"prose\">The regressions compare entries within the same concept, year and host. This view is rougher on purpose: it takes the recorded events as they are, splits them at a host-vocabulary share you choose, and counts how often each group reached an uptake bar you choose. Every rate is recomputed in the page from the embedded events. These are raw rates with no fixed effects or controls, so they are not the paper's estimates.</p>\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-whatif\">\n    <p class=\"vq\">If \"took root\" means at least <i>k</i> newcomer papers, how much more often do high-share entries clear the bar?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <label>Fold <select id=\"w-fold\"><option value=\"screen\">Screen</option><option value=\"heldout\">Held-out</option><option value=\"mesh\">MeSH</option></select></label>\n      <div class=\"rng\"><label for=\"w-tau\">Host-share split</label><input type=\"range\" id=\"w-tau\" min=\"0.005\" max=\"0.20\" step=\"0.005\" value=\"0.05\"><output id=\"w-tau-o\" for=\"w-tau\"></output></div>\n      <div class=\"rng\"><label for=\"w-k\">Uptake bar <i>k</i> (newcomer papers)</label><input type=\"range\" id=\"w-k\" min=\"1\" max=\"10\" step=\"1\" value=\"1\"><output id=\"w-k-o\" for=\"w-k\"></output></div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"grid2\" style=\"grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.3fr)\">\n      <div><h4>Split at your threshold</h4><div class=\"chart\" id=\"w-split\"></div></div>\n      <div><h4>By fifth of host-vocabulary share</h4><div class=\"chart\" id=\"w-quint\"></div></div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"w-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<section class=\"sec\" id=\"fails\" aria-labelledby=\"h-fails\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-fails\">Where it fails</h2>\n  <p class=\"prose\">The effect is not uniform. Pick a weak spot to see the rows behind it.</p>\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-fails\">\n    <p class=\"vq\">Which tests of the host-vocabulary effect come back null or inconclusive?</p>\n    <div class=\"fails\" id=\"fail-btns\"></div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"f-chart\"></div>\n    <p class=\"note\" id=\"f-note\"></p>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"f-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n  <h3>What the paper does not show</h3>\n  <ul class=\"prose lim\">\n    <li><strong>The main-arm folds are development sets.</strong> Event counts, population sizes and gating decisions were computed on both the Screen and Held-out folds before grafting outcomes were read. The independent evidence comes from the MeSH replication.</li>\n    <li><strong>Population bias.</strong> The concept pool is dominated by physics, physical-sciences and computer-science concepts from arXiv. The MeSH population covers only biomedicine-to-biomedicine entries. Social sciences, humanities and engineering are untested.</li>\n    <li><strong>Single-paper entries.</strong> 87% of co-primary Screen events involve a single entry-year paper. The pooled multi-team effect is positive (IRR 1.28, 95% CI 1.11 to 1.48), but the Held-out fold alone is underpowered for this test.</li>\n    <li><strong>Cluster-robust inference over-rejects.</strong> The cluster-robust variance estimator rejects 10% to 11% of null shuffles in simulation (target 5%). Wild-cluster bootstrap and permutation tests agree on the Held-out fold (wild p = 0.012, permutation p = 0.026).</li>\n    <li><strong>Host-specificity is only partly tested.</strong> The Balassa-index lift measure correlates 0.997 with the log of the host-vocabulary share within fixed effects, so it confirms the continuous measure rather than adding independent evidence.</li>\n    <li><strong>Adopter evidence is Screen-only.</strong> The enrichment for prior partner exposure (OR 3.09) is not independently confirmed, and the design cannot separate absorptive capacity from topical proximity.</li>\n    <li><strong>Closure on the Held-out fold.</strong> Matching falls back to Screen controls for 17 of 25 unique controls, and the MeSH closure result is null under the primary label.</li>\n  </ul>\n</div>\n</section>\n</main>\n\n<footer id=\"notes\" aria-labelledby=\"h-notes\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-notes\">Links, sources and glossary</h2>\n  <div class=\"links\" style=\"margin-bottom:22px\">\n    <a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_F1tk5OGtH84L/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n    <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_F1tk5OGtH84L/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n    <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new/tree/fork/run_F1tk5OGtH84L\">Code repository</a>\n  </div>\n  <h3>Data provenance</h3>\n  <p class=\"note\">Each view reads an embedded JSON block produced by a script from these artifact output files.
